title: Nectarine French Crumble
description: A French-inspired dessert featuring fresh nectarines topped with a crunchy crumble mixture.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced nectarines and granulated sugar. Let it sit for 15 minutes.
Transfer the nectarine mixture to a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour and unsalted butter until crumbly.
Add the crumble mixture to the top of the nectarine mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream if desired.
